definitions.short: a species of rock-rabbit (from its hiding ), i.e. probably the hyrax
definitions.full: H8227. shaphan שָׁפָן noun masculine Lev 11:5 rock-badger , hyrax syriacus , AV RV coney ; — absolute ׳שׁ Deut 14:7 = Lev 11:5 (P; unclean animal); living in rocks, plural שְׁפַנִּים Psa 104:18 ; Prov 30:26 . — See Rob BR iii. 66, 387 Tr NHB 75; FFP 1, and Plural 1 Post Hast. DB CONEY McLean-Shipley Ency. Bib. ID .
